name: Berbere – Ethiopian Spice Blend
shortDescription: A warming Ethiopian spice blend for stews, sauces, meat, vegetables and legumes.
description: Bring depth and aromatic spice to everyday cooking with Berbere. This finely ground blend can be stirred into wot, sauces, marinades and vegetable dishes. Add gradually and adjust the amount to suit your recipe.
alt: Zewid Market Berbere 1 kg in an opaque gold pouch with the new bilingual label and website QR code
ingredientsEn: Paprika, Garlic, Ginger, Fenugreek, Cardamom, Rue, Basil, Rosemary, Clove, Nutmeg, Salt, Thyme, Cinnamon, Cumin, Long pepper, Black pepper.
ingredientsFi: Paprika, valkosipuli, inkivääri, sarviapila, kardemumma, ruuta, basilika, rosmariini, neilikka, muskottipähkinä, suola, timjami, kaneli, juustokumina, pitkäpippuri ja mustapippuri.

name: Mitmita – Ethiopian Chilli Spice Blend
shortDescription: A fiery Ethiopian chilli blend for sprinkling over cooked dishes or stirring into sauces.
description: Mitmita is an Ethiopian chilli seasoning with a bold, aromatic flavour. Use a small pinch as a finishing condiment on cooked meat, vegetables or cheese, or add it to sauces when you want extra heat. Start with a little and season to taste.
alt: Zewid Market Mitmita 500 g in an opaque gold pouch with the new bilingual label and website QR code
ingredientsEn: Bird’s-eye chilli, cardamom, koseret, salt, nech azmud and rosemary.
ingredientsFi: Linnunsilmächili, kardemumma, koseret, suola, nech azmud ja rosmariini.

name: Bula – Ethiopian Enset Starch
shortDescription: Fine white starch from the Ethiopian enset plant for cooked porridge and thickening.
description: Bula is the fine white starch extracted from enset, also known as false banana. It is used in Ethiopian cooking to prepare a smooth cooked porridge and can also be used to thicken soups. Mix with a little cool water before adding to hot liquid and cook while stirring.
alt: Zewid Market Bula 1 kg in an opaque gold pouch with the new bilingual label and website QR code

name: Korerima – Ethiopian Cardamom Powder
shortDescription: Aromatic ground Ethiopian cardamom seeds for spice blends, stews and spiced butter.
description: Korerima is Ethiopian cardamom, made from the seeds of Aframomum corrorima. Its warm, smoky and citrus-like aroma adds character to Ethiopian spice blends, stews and spiced butter. Add a small amount during cooking and adjust to taste.
alt: Zewid Market Korerima 250 g in an opaque gold pouch with the new bilingual label and website QR code

name: Shiro
shortDescription: Traditional Ethiopian Shiro powder. Easy to prepare and makes a delicious, savory stew.
description: Traditional Ethiopian Shiro powder. Easy to prepare and makes a delicious, savory stew.
alt: Zewid Market Shiro 1 kg in an opaque gold pouch with the new bilingual label and website QR code
ingredientsEn: Chickpea, garlic, onion, basil, rue, ajwain and peppers.
ingredientsFi: Kikherne, valkosipuli, sipuli, basilika, ruuta, ajowan ja paprikat.

name: Ethiopian Mekelesha Spice Mix – 100 g
shortDescription: Aromatic Ethiopian finishing spice blend for stews and savoury dishes.
description: Mekelesha is commonly added near the end of cooking to give Ethiopian stews and sauces their finishing aroma. Use it in dishes such as doro wat and other richly seasoned recipes, adjusting the amount to taste.
alt: Zewid Market Ethiopian Mekelesha Spice Mix 100 g in an opaque gold pouch with the new bilingual label and website QR code

name: Ethiopian Sidamo Arabica Green Coffee Beans – 1 kg
shortDescription: Washed Grade 1 Ethiopian Sidamo Arabica beans, unroasted for fresh home roasting.
description: These green Sidamo coffee beans are intended for customers who enjoy roasting coffee themselves. Roast the beans to your preferred level, then grind and brew them. They are particularly suitable for the Ethiopian coffee ceremony, where coffee is traditionally roasted fresh before serving.
alt: Zewid Market Sidamo unroasted Arabica coffee beans 1 kg in an opaque gold pouch with a bilingual label and website QR code
